title: Sprint 5 - Sorting, Limiting & Updating
description: Complete all SQL queries in this sprint.

tickets.title: Sort Tasks Ascending
tickets.description: Get the `id` and `title` of all tasks, ordered by priority in ascending order.
tasks: Get the `id` and `title` of all tasks, ordered by priority in ascending order.
hints: ASC is the default, but write it explicitly for practice.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT id, title FROM todos ORDER BY priority ASC, id ASC;

solution.query.sql: SELECT id, title FROM todos ORDER BY priority ASC;

tickets.title: Top 5 Recent Tasks (DESC)
tickets.description: Get the 5 most recently created todos (assuming highest ID is most recent). Fetch their `id` and `title`.
tasks: Get the 5 most recently created todos (assuming highest ID is most recent). Fetch their `id` and `title`.
learning_objectives: Combining ORDER BY ... DESC and LIMIT.
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT id, title FROM todos ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5;

solution.query.sql: SELECT id, title FROM todos ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 5;

tickets.title: Complete a Task
tickets.description: Task with `id = 1` has been finished. Change its status to 'completed'.
tasks: Task with `id = 1` has been finished. Change its status to 'completed'.
learning_objectives: Using UPDATE with a specific WHERE condition.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the WHERE clause (updates all rows).
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT * FROM todos ORDER BY id;

solution.query.sql: UPDATE todos SET status = 'completed' WHERE id = 1;

tickets.title: Delete Old Data
tickets.description: Delete any todos that belong to `user_id = 2`.
tasks: Delete any todos that belong to `user_id = 2`.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the WHERE clause (deletes all rows).
hints: Read the SQLite documentation for the specific keyword.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT * FROM todos ORDER BY id;

tickets.title: Increment Priority
tickets.description: Increase the `priority` of all pending todos by 1.
tasks: Increase the `priority` of all pending todos by 1.
common_mistakes: Forgetting the WHERE clause or using wrong math syntax.

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT * FROM todos ORDER BY id;

solution.query.sql: UPDATE todos SET priority = priority + 1 WHERE status = 'pending';

tickets.title: Drop Column
tickets.description: Remove the `due_date` column entirely from the `todos` table.
tasks: Remove the `due_date` column entirely from the `todos` table.
learning_objectives: Using ALTER TABLE to drop columns.
common_mistakes: Forgetting to specify the column name or using older SQLite syntax.
hints: ALTER TABLE table_name DROP COLUMN column_name;

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='todos';

solution.query.sql: ALTER TABLE todos DROP COLUMN due_date;

tickets.title: Rename Column
tickets.description: Rename the `title` column to `task_name` in the `todos` table.
tasks: Rename the `title` column to `task_name` in the `todos` table.
learning_objectives: Using ALTER TABLE to rename columns.
hints: ALTER TABLE table_name RENAME COLUMN old_name TO new_name;

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='todos';

solution.query.sql: ALTER TABLE todos RENAME COLUMN title TO task_name;

tickets.title: Replace a Row
tickets.description: Replace user with `id = 2` (Bob) with a new profile having the username 'Robert' and no email address (email = NULL).
tasks: Replace user with `id = 2` (Bob) with a new profile having the username 'Robert' and no email address (email = NULL).
learning_objectives: Overwriting a row with specific column updates.
common_mistakes: Omitting email field update or forgetting WHERE clause.
hints: Use UPDATE users SET username = 'Robert', email = NULL WHERE id = 2;

scoring_rules.system_query: SELECT * FROM users ORDER BY id;

solution.query.sql: UPDATE users SET username = 'Robert', email = NULL WHERE id = 2;
